hypothesis: The integration of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques with de novo molecular design can enhance the efficiency and accuracy of drug discovery by enabling the generation of novel compounds that are both chemically valid and tailored to specific biological targets. By leveraging the strengths of RAG models, which combine parametric and non-parametric memory to access vast chemical knowledge, researchers can explore unknown chemical spaces more effectively and generate drug-like candidates from scratch, thus potentially reducing the time and cost associated with traditional drug design methods [2005.11401:0][denovo-genai-survey:0].
